retrievalProfile.description: A classic mid-century layout featuring a close-up candid portrait framed by a thick solid border with a high-contrast pairing of bold sans-serif and elegant cursive script.
triggerTerms: candid profile portrait with bold typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic portrait of a male subject in profile, encased within a wide, solid blue border. The typography is layered directly over the upper third of the image, utilizing a stark white color to pop against the dark hair and background of the photo.
coreVisualRelationships: Thick outer border framing a central square image
Bold geometric sans-serif paired with fluid handwriting
High-contrast white text against dark photographic areas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait filling the central square, slightly offset to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold sans-serif name at the top center-left of the image area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold name, flows down through the script title, follows the subject's profile line to the bottom credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid blue border acts as a massive frame of negative space, focusing all attention on the central square.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark brown hair (subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark background; muted, natural saturation in the photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and rhythmic cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Upper-case sans-serif with thick, even strokes
Cursive script with variable line weight and connected letters
Slanted baseline for the script elements

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over dark hair for contrast
integrated with the subject's forehead area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, authoritative sans-serif paired with personal, intimate handwriting for a 'star' and 'song' relationship.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the primary text.
Captures the informal, rhythmic quality of the cursive subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square candid profile photograph of a man with dark hair and a light blue shirt collar, then place it inside a thick, solid medium-blue square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif at the top center. Below it, add the title in a white, flowing cursive script.

verificationChecks: Is the border solid and thick?
Is the top text bold and uppercase?
Is the second line of text a script font?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific face or name from the original
Do not replicate the specific circular logo in the corner

mustAchieve: High legibility of white text over the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for the thick blue border
Verify the sans-serif and script font pairing
Ensure the portrait is in profile
Confirm the text is centered and white
recipe.reuseFormula: Square Photo + Thick Solid Border + (Bold Sans-Serif / Script) Overlay = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
